description: The bar chart titled “Factual Errors” illustrates the number of factual errors across several datasets for three QA methods. The category axis is horizontal and lists datasets in left-to-right order as 2WikiMQA, MuSiQue, and IIRC (with an additional leftmost group partially visible), while the value axis is vertical with a linear numeric scale labeled by tick marks at regular intervals (approximately every 5 units) spanning from about 0 up to at least 30. Each dataset category contains a grouped set of three adjacent bars corresponding to the legend at the top: “NoR QA” shown as an orange bar with a grid pattern, “OneR QA” shown as a red bar with a dotted pattern, and a third method shown as a dark blue bar with diagonal hatching. For the partially visible leftmost group, the orange, red, and blue bars are labeled approximately 15, 10, and 5, respectively. For 2WikiMQA, the orange bar is labeled 29, the red bar 23, and the blue bar 14. For MuSiQue, the orange bar is labeled 28, the red bar 27, and the blue bar 23. For IIRC, the orange bar is labeled 15, the red bar 14, and the blue bar 11. The bars are not shown as stacked; they are grouped side-by-side within each dataset, and each bar has its value annotated above it; no special highlighting beyond the distinct colors/patterns is indicated, and the category order does not appear to be explicitly sorted by bar height.
